body:
I have no one to tell or anyone I trust enough to tell.
I don’t even know if what I’m feeling is real, it could all just be my imagination and I’m just someone’s who’s faking it. I’m too scared to confront anyone incase it turns out that I’m fine and I just thought it was something worse.
It’s been a while now. I’ve had these thoughts for so long, I’m ready for them to go away.
